options.content:
**Caller (Client spans)**：服务作为调用方发出的 outbound 请求（含下游时延）。

**Callee (Server spans)**：服务作为被调方处理的 inbound 请求（服务端处理时延）。

故障注入（Chaos Mesh）与压测（Locust）期间，对比 Caller/Callee 的 QPS、时延、错误率与各 Pod 资源指标变化。

panels.description: 各服务作为被调方处理的请求速率（SPAN_KIND_SERVER，避免与 client 双算）
panels.title: Callee QPS (入站 RPS)

panels.description: 入站请求错误率 = STATUS_CODE_ERROR / 全部 server spans

targets.expr:
(
  sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", service_name!~"chaos.*", service_name=~"$service"}[2m]))
  /
  sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name!~"chaos.*", service_name=~"$service"}[2m]))
)

panels.title: Callee 错误率

panels.description: 入站请求平均响应时延（ms）

targets.expr:
sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name!~"chaos.*", service_name=~"$service"}[2m]))
/
sum by (service_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name!~"chaos.*", service_name=~"$service"}[2m]))

panels.title: Callee 平均时延

panels.description: 入站 P50

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", service_name!~"chaos.*", service_name=~"$service"}[2m])))

panels.description: 各 Pod CPU 使用核数

panels.description: CPU 使用 / Pod CPU limit

targets.expr:
100 *
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="onlineboutique", pod=~"$service.*", container!="", container!="POD"}[2m]))
/
sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu", namespace="onlineboutique", pod=~"$service.*", container!="", container!="POD"} )

panels.title: CPU 利用率 (% of limit)
